lines.text: After twenty years of building the LORD's house and his palace, Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram gave him and settled Israelites there.
Solomon captured Hamath-zobah, built Tadmor in the wilderness, and rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities.
Solomon made the remaining Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites forced laborers, and made the Israelites his builders and stonecutters.

wrong_details.true: his men of war and commanders

lines.text: Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter out of the house of David because it was too small, then appointed priests, Levites and gatekeepers by David's ordinances.

wrong_details.true: because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy

lines.text: Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the coast of Edom, where Hiram sent ships and sailors to Ophir for gold.
